title: Reference names infraweave serves or reads under another name
description: Decision 0001's rename table. An identifier row names one reference name and its replacement; TestUnitServedNames refuses the reference name in every served bundle. A concept row names a reference concept in words.

schema.description: For an identifier: the component schema whose property or enum value is renamed. Absent, the name is renamed wherever it is served.

reference.description: For an identifier, the reference name, where * stands for any run of characters; for a concept, markdown.
